title: MessLoc Demo Request Bodies
description: Valid, realistic demo JSON request payloads matching exact DTO definitions and Jakarta validation constraints for all endpoints accepting a request body.

userSignup.description: Registers a regular customer account. Role is automatically set to USER, and status is ACTIVE.

ownerSignup.description: Registers a mess owner account. Role is automatically set to OWNER, status is PENDING admin verification, and OwnerProfile is initialized.

payload.name: Karan Joshi
payload.businessDescription: Authentic North Indian thali, wholesome tiffin packages, and hygienic home-style meal service for students and working professionals.
payload.businessAddress: Plot 12, Clock Tower, Rajpur Road, Dehradun

userSignin.description: Standard sign-in payload for a verified ACTIVE customer.

ownerSignin.description: Sign-in payload for an approved ACTIVE mess owner.

adminSignin.description: Sign-in payload for the platform administrator.

userExample.description: Customer profile update. Only mutable safe fields (name, phone, city, profileImage) are accepted. Protected fields (id, email, password, role, status) are immutable.

ownerExample.description: Owner personal profile update. Updates the underlying User identity record.

createMess.description: Creates a new mess listing by an authenticated ACTIVE owner. verificationStatus is server-assigned as PENDING and status as ACTIVE.

payload.name: Annapurna Royal Mess
payload.description: Premium pure veg North Indian meals with unlimited chapatis, salad, dessert on weekends, and hygienic RO water.
payload.address: 45/2 Subhash Nagar, Near Graphic Era University

updateMess.description: Updates details of a mess owned by the authenticated owner. Server enforces ownership check and coordinate/time validation.

payload.name: Annapurna Royal Mess & Caterers
payload.description: Newly renovated premium veg & non-veg meals with special Sunday desserts and unlimited salad bar.

createAdmin.description: Creates a new administrator account. Only existing ADMINs can invoke this. Role is strictly assigned ADMIN and status is ACTIVE.
